We specialize in DJ entertainment, MC services, live musicians, photo booths, lighting design, and event production for weddings, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, corporate events, birthday parties, school dances, and private celebrations. $100K+ annual revenue and growing. step5_design.design_notes: THIS IS A $100K+ PROFESSIONAL EVENT ENTERTAINMENT COMPANY. The site must look like a premium agency — clean, elegant, professional. NOT cyberpunk. NOT startup tech. NOT generic AI-generated. Think luxury event venue marketing — the kind of site that makes a bride say 'these are the people I want at my wedding.' DESIGN RULES: 1) CLEAN premium fonts — use Inter or Outfit for body, Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for headings. NO generic sans-serif. 2) DARK MODE: Background #0F0F1A or #1A1A2E. ALL text must be bright white (#FFFFFF or #F0F2F5). NO GREY TEXT. NO DIM TEXT. NO zinc-500, slate-400, or any muted color on any text anywhere. Font weight 500+ for body, 700+ for headings. 3) LIGHT MODE: Background #FAFAFA or #FFFFFF. ALL text must be near-black (#1A1A2E or #111111). NO GREY TEXT. 4) Gold accents (#C9A84C or #D4AF37) for CTAs, highlights, borders, icons. 5) Dark/light mode toggle on every page. 6) NO SCROLLING HELLSCAPE. Each page fits in 1-2 viewport heights maximum. Use tabs, accordions, sub-navigation instead of stacking content vertically. If a section has more than 4 cards, use tabs or a carousel — not a vertical list. 7) Services page uses a sub-nav or tab system — DJ/MC, Weddings, Mitzvahs, Corporate, Parties, Lighting, Live Music. Click to see each service. Not 13 cards stacked vertically. 8) Photo Booths is its own page with Mirror Me and Mirror Air as two featured sections with visuals, descriptions, and pricing. 9) Gallery uses filter buttons — not all photos in a vertical scroll. Click category, see those photos. 10) Reviews shows 3 featured with a 'Read More' button, not 5 full cards stacked. 11) Contact is form + info side by side, FAQ in accordion. One viewport. 12) Team section uses a clean card grid — name, role, one line bio. Not giant cards with paragraphs. 13) Use stock photos from picsum.photos for placeholders. Do NOT use source.unsplash.com (deprecated, returns 404). 14) Mobile responsive with hamburger nav. 15) Smooth transitions and hover effects — subtle, not flashy.

step8_budget.additional_notes: This is a REAL business doing $100K+ annually in event entertainment. The site must be professional enough that a corporate event planner or a mother planning her daughter's Bat Mitzvah would immediately trust this company. Bar/Bat Mitzvahs are a major specialty (20-30 per year) but the company does ALL events — weddings, corporate, birthdays, school dances, private parties. Do NOT make it look mitzvah-only. Show the full breadth. Photo Booths (Mirror Me and Mirror Air from Fotomaster) are premium add-ons and deserve their own page. The team is real — 3 MCs/DJs who also lead the company, 3 additional DJs, and 4 professional dancers. Use their real names and roles. Use stock photos for now — do NOT use source.unsplash.com (broken). Use picsum.photos or CSS gradient placeholders.
